Subject: Sandbox access + credits request — SignalWorks onboarding

Hi Vivek,

We just completed the self-serve signup and we're kicking off a short POC to validate inference latency and cost for our chat summarization use case. The onboarding form asked us to reach out for sandbox credits if we need to run larger evaluation tests.

Quick details:
- Org: SignalWorks (signalworks.io)
- Intended workload: chat summarization + light retrieval (~3k requests/day, peak 800 reqs/day)
- Preferred model: open-llama/13b or guidance from Redwood catalog
- Requested: 50k tokens of eval credits to run a couple of full-pass tests over our prompt sets

Attached is a short doc with expected traffic and a couple of sample prompts. Please let me know what info you need to approve this. We're trying to get results by end of next week.

Thanks,
Maya R.
Senior Product Manager
SignalWorks

Attachment: signalworks-initial-requirements.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Hi Maya — welcome and thanks for the details. I'm Vivek on the self-serve growth team; I'll triage and get you a fast answer. Two quick asks so we can route this: 

1) Can you confirm whether any of the data you'll send includes customer PII? If yes, we'll loop security; if no, we can expedite credits.
2) Do you have an existing Redwood HubSpot/Account record? If not, we'll create one (we'll need a billing contact email).

Tentative plan: if non-PII and small-scale eval, we can approve a sandbox grant (50k tokens) with 30-day expiry. Marissa — can you review for approval? Ben — FYI in case we want to offer a short demo or pointers on model selection.

Thanks,
Vivek

Hi Maya — congrats on getting the signup through. I attached a quick starter checklist and recommended config. High level: prefer 8-bit quantized 13B for latency/cost tradeoff; batch sizes 8-16 depending on prompt length; keep prefix caching enabled for repeated contexts.

I'll also ping our solutions doc in the shared Drive. Let us know if you want a 30-minute setup call.

—Ben
